text: Playing the music on this phone is now free for everyone: your library, playlists, the basic equalizer, Chromecast and the sleep timer. Shuttle Music Pro is one bundle: your Jellyfin, Emby, Plex and Subsonic servers with their downloads, Android Auto, batch tag editing, the advanced equalizer and replay gain, as a one-time unlock. You can try it free for 14 days, and the trial only starts when you ask for it. Earlier purchases carry over as Pro at no extra cost, with our thanks. If you have not bought Pro yet, you can start a fresh 14-day trial.
